paper_title: Solution-processed bulk heterojunction solar cells based on BF2-hydroxychalcone complexes

knowledge_points.content: BF2-hydroxychalcone complexes featuring a triphenylamine (TPA) terminal unit can be synthesized in a straightforward two-step process using cheap starting materials.
knowledge_points.evidence: it is remarkable that the chalcone-BF2 species can be obtained straightforwardly involving cheap starting materials in a very simple two-step synthetic route.

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of a triphenylamine (TPA) unit into BF2-hydroxychalcone complexes improves their solubility in organic solvents and enhances their chemical stability against hydrolytic boron decomplexation.
knowledge_points.evidence: The introduction of the TPA unit endowed the three compounds with both good solubility in organic solvents and increased chemical stability vs. hydrolytic boron decomplexation.

knowledge_points.content: BF2-hydroxychalcone dyes 1-3 exhibit high molar absorption coefficients of approximately 70,000 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹ in dichloromethane solution, attributed to π-π* transitions with high intramolecular charge transfer character.
knowledge_points.evidence: The electronic absorption spectra (Fig. 1 and Table 1) of the three dyes in DCM solution display an intense transition band in the visible region with a very high molar absorption coefficient (i.e. 70 000 M−1 cm−1).

knowledge_points.content: The optical band gaps (Eg) of the BF2-hydroxychalcone dyes 1, 2, and 3 in thin films are estimated to be between 1.55 eV and 1.77 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: Optical band gap values (Eg) between 1.5 and 1.8 eV were evaluated from the onset of the long wavelength absorption edge of the film... Table 1: Dye 1 (1.77 eV), Dye 2 (1.65 eV), Dye 3 (1.55 eV).

knowledge_points.content: Substitution on the acetophenone ring of the BF2-hydroxychalcone complex influences the energy levels; for instance, a methoxy substituent in Dye 1 increases the first anodic peak potential (Epa1) to 0.78 V compared to Dye 2 (0.57 V).
knowledge_points.evidence: The methoxy substituent in dye 1 increases the value of Epa1 to 0.78 V... Dye 2 (0.57 V).

knowledge_points.content: The best-performing organic solar cell based on Dye 1:PC61BM (1:4 weight ratio) achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 1.13% with a Jsc of 4.97 mA cm⁻², Voc of 0.598 V, and FF of 0.38.
knowledge_points.evidence: The best performance was achieved for a device with a 43 nm thick active layer based on 1 that displayed a PCE value of 1.13% (Jsc = 4.97 mA cm−2, Voc = 0.598 V, FF = 0.38).

knowledge_points.content: Reducing the active layer thickness of Dye 1:PC61BM blends from 187 nm to 43 nm improved charge collection and increased the short-circuit current (Jsc) by approximately 30%.
knowledge_points.evidence: Decreasing the thickness improved charge collection, giving higher values of short-circuit current (+30%) and smaller values of the series resistance.

knowledge_points.content: Replacing aluminum (Al) with a calcium/aluminum (Ca/Al) bilayer cathode significantly improved the open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Jsc) by reducing leakage currents and providing a better work function match.
knowledge_points.evidence: Higher values of the shunt resistance were obtained using Ca/Al instead of Al as the top electrode metal and leakage currents were reduced. As a consequence... the use of calcium combined with the decrease in the active layer thickness provided significant improvement of both Jsc and Voc.

knowledge_points.content: o-Dichlorobenzene (o-DCB) was identified as a superior processing solvent for Dye 1 compared to chlorobenzene or solvent mixtures, as it enabled better rectifying behavior in the dark characteristics.
knowledge_points.evidence: o-Dichlorobenzene (o-DCB) did not significantly change device performances but allowed some rectifying behaviour as noticed in the dark characteristics... o-DCB was thus selected for the following investigation.

knowledge_points.content: The external quantum efficiency (EQE) spectrum of Dye 1-based devices shows photoresponse contributions from PC61BM at 337 nm and the dye's lowest-energy transition at 575 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: The EQE spectrum presents three bands centred at 337, 400 and 575 nm. The first band corresponds to the contribution of the PC61BM while the last one is associated with the lowest-energy transition band of compound 1.

knowledge_points.content: The HOMO and LUMO energy levels for Dye 1 are estimated at -5.58 eV and -3.81 eV, respectively, based on electrochemical oxidation potentials and the optical band gap.
knowledge_points.evidence: Table 1: Dye 1 EHOMO -5.58 eV, ELUMO -3.81 eV.

knowledge_points.content: A high acceptor loading (dye:PC61BM weight ratio of 1:4) was utilized for the fabrication of the active layer in these small-molecule BHJ solar cells.
knowledge_points.evidence: The donor-acceptor layer was obtained from mixtures of dyes 1 and 3... with PC61BM in chlorobenzene (CB) as solvent at a dye/PC61BM weight ratio of 1:4.
